title: West Side Panic!
text: Preppers in the area: combat roll 4+ or lose 2 HEALTH

title: Stray dog sniffing around
text: Roll RISK DICE. 1-2: Bitten, lose 1 HEALTH; 3-6: spend 1 FOOD to tame and keep the dog

title: Hospital worker offers contraband meds
text: You may swap any 2 resources for 3 MEDS

title: Stab vest at pawn shop!
text: First to get there pays 1 PREPCOIN or 1 TECH to acquire

title: Crypto price soars!
text: Any prepper with TECH may exchange each for 2 PREPCOIN

title: Med centers packed with panicking patients!
text: Hospital closed until this card is covered

title: Have hazmat suit - need food
text: First prepper to reach the bar may acquire for 1 FOOD

title: Anti-tech rioters hit East Side!
text: Any prepper in the east area loses 1 TECH

title: Airborne outbreak!
text: All preppers pay 1 MED or lose 2 HEALTH

title: Emergency curfew imposed!
text: No night-time movement until this card is covered

title: Rogue AI devalues all crypto!
text: All players lose 2 PREPCOIN

title: Bent building manager
text: First to reach steel plant may swap 2 TECH for solar panel

title: Powerplant pollution!
text: Preppers on or adjacent to river lose 1 MED or 1 HEALTH

title: You brew "Ale-pocalypse" beer - it's good stuff!
text: Gain 2 FOOD and 2 KNOW-HOW

title: Bug-out test simulation
text: Roll a dice. 1-2: lose 1 KNOW-HOW; 3-6: lose 1 KNOW-HOW (as printed - check)

title: Panic-buyers' bags burst!
text: Place 2 MEDS on West Street and 3 FOOD on Law Street

title: Turn all tech off and on again
text: Lose 1 TECH unless you have 2 or more KNOW-HOW

title: City-wide blackout!
text: Any prepper without a flashlight loses 1 resource

title: Citizens trade old hard drives to buy canned food
text: Place 3 TECH in pawn shop

title: Crypto-geek's hideout found!
text: Place 3 PREPCOIN and 3 TECH in the boat yard

title: Train drops vital aid package
text: Place 1 of each resource at the train station

title: Red-hot briefcase on subway!
text: Subway stations are closed until this card is covered

title: You get drunk and throw up on your short-wave radio
text: Lose 1 TECH and 1 HEALTH

title: Thugs asleep on the job!
text: All preppers lose 1 resource for each thug they employ

title: Truck dumps chemical waste
text: Any prepper in central area loses 2 HEALTH

title: Brain boil or boffin boost?
text: Each roll a dice: 1-2 lose 2 HEALTH; 3-6 gain 1 KNOW-HOW

title: Daring dumpster dive
text: First prepper to reach a dumpster takes top ITEM card
